w:r.w:t: Students & Guardians dashboard module: student records, guardians, enrollments, documents, medical profile, notes, profile correction requests, and registration.
The frontend has a large student UI/UX surface, but it is not fully aligned with the backend. Several flows are partial, mock-backed, disabled, or permission-gated incorrectly.

The Student area in the frontend is visually substantial and includes a students list, student profile tabs, guardian cards, document tables, notes, medical notes, enrollment history, timeline, and account-linking modals. However, the implementation is not complete against the backend contract. The main issue is not the absence of UI, but incomplete integration: some actions are disabled, some pages use mock/demo file URLs, some frontend API adapters call endpoints that were not found in the backend, and several backend-supported workflows have no dashboard UI.
Core student list/get/update/timeline is mostly implemented.
Student creation is supported by the backend but the frontend button is disabled.
Guardian list/create/update/link/unlink is mostly implemented, but guardian-link update is disabled and permissions need alignment.
Enrollment display exists, but enrollment create/validate/upsert management UI is missing or not exposed.
Student documents list/missing/upload exists, but view/download are mock URLs and import-from-application is missing.
Medical profile UI only edits notes, while the backend supports blood type, allergies, conditions, and medications.
Notes list/create is implemented, but edit/update UI is disabled although backend and service support update.
Profile correction requests and school registration are backend-supported but missing from the frontend dashboard.
Several management buttons are not gated by the same permissions required by backend endpoints.
